tools.name: purge_declined_events_in_range
tools.description: Looks up events in a date range on a calendar database and permanently deletes those where every invitee has declined. Returns the titles of the deleted events.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: ID of the calendar to clean up

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB = "calendar.db"


@tool
def purge_declined_events_in_range(calendar_id: str, start: str, end: str) -> list:
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = c.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT e.id, e.title FROM events e WHERE e.calendar_id = ? AND e.starts_at >= ? AND e.starts_at < ?",
        (calendar_id, start, end),
    )
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    gone = []
    for eid, title in rows:
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(status = 'declined') FROM invitees WHERE event_id = ?", (eid,))
        n, d = cur.fetchone()
        if n and n == (d or 0):
            cur.execute("DELETE FROM invitees WHERE event_id = ?", (eid,))
            cur.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE id = ?", (eid,))
            gone.append(title)
    c.commit()
    c.close()
    return gone

tools.name: grant_calendar_editor_access
tools.description: Checks the calendar's current sharing list and then gives a user editor access to it in the calendar service. Returns the user's previous role and the new role.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: ID of the calendar to share

params.name: user_email
params.description: Email of the user receiving editor access

tools.code:
import os
import requests

BASE = os.environ.get("CAL_API_URL", "https://calendar.internal.example.com/api/v1")
HEADERS = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ.get("CAL_API_TOKEN", "")}


def grant_calendar_editor_access(calendar_id: str, user_email: str) -> dict:
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE}/calendars/{calendar_id}/acl", headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
    r.raise_for_status()
    rules = r.json().get("items", [])
    prev = next((x["role"] for x in rules if x["email"] == user_email), "none")
    p = requests.put(
        f"{BASE}/calendars/{calendar_id}/acl/{user_email}",
        json={"role": "editor"},
        headers=HEADERS,
        timeout=10,
    )
    p.raise_for_status()
    return {"calendar_id": calendar_id, "user": user_email, "previous_role": prev, "new_role": "editor"}

tools.name: archive_past_events_and_run_export
tools.description: Moves a calendar's events that ended before a cutoff date into the archive table, then runs the export script to write the archived events to a file. Returns the number of events moved and the export script's exit code.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: ID of the calendar to archive

params.name: cutoff
params.description: ISO date; events ending before this are archived

params.name: export_path
params.description: Output file path for the export
